entities.summary: Al-Nābighah, al-Nābighah al-Dhubiyānī, or Nābighah al-Dhubyānī; real name Ziyad ibn Muawiyah ; was one of the last pre-Islamic Arabian poets. "Al-Nabigha" means genius or intelligent in Arabic.
